name: Lén Línfiaclach

attributes.attribute: made beautiful things for the fairy queen Fand
threw his anvil eastward each night

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lén Línfiaclach is a lesser hero of old Ireland. The tales call him one of the craft gods. He lived in a lake and made beautiful things for the fairy queen Fand. Each night he threw his anvil eastward. It left three paths behind it, of water, of fire, and of purple stones. From them he gathered what his craft needed.

okr.objective: Record the Irish craft hero Lén Línfiaclach.
